headline: Indian markets surge ahead of Diwali Muhurat Trading as Dalal Street enters Samvat 2083 on a high note

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Strong global cues and robust buying propelled Sensex up by over 1,700 to 2,000 points in recent sessions.
Indian equities bucked a broader global technology rout to post their strongest weekly performance in six years.
Investors added approximately Rs 8 lakh crore in wealth during a single trading session rally.
Optimism surrounds the start of Samvat 2083 as Nifty holds key technical support levels.
whatHappening: Dalal Street marks the beginning of Samvat 2083 with special Muhurat Trading scheduled for Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Sensex rallied past the 81,000 milestone while Nifty 50 reclaimed the 24,500 mark.
Peak XV and Y Combinator sold stake worth Rs 2,457 crore in Groww via secondary transactions.
Market historical data shows an 80% positive strike rate for benchmark indices during past Muhurat Trading sessions.
summary: Indian benchmark indices registered strong rallies ahead of Diwali, with Sensex surging past 81,000 and Nifty reclaiming key levels. Dalal Street enters Samvat 2083 with optimism after bucking global technology selloffs to record strong gains. Exchanges are conducting the traditional Muhurat Trading session today on Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
